Kimley-Horn's Akron, Ohio (OH) office is seeking an Electrical Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join their Water/Wastewater Electrical team! This is not a remote position and could require up to 20% travel of any given year as project and non-project needs demand.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible with assisting in the design of water transmission and distribution systems, pumping stations, conveyance systems, water treatment systems, water/wastewater distribution planning, master planning, and treatment plant rehabilitation and expansions
  • Manage electrical, instrumentation, and controls projects for public- and private-sector water and wastewater pump stations, treatment facilities, and related utility infrastructure
  • Manage project scope, fees, schedules, staffing, multidisciplinary coordination, and client communication
  • Serve as Engineer of Record, including plans, specifications, and other engineering
